title: A bit flimsy
text: A bit flimsy. I was so excited to receive this knife set but upon testing them,  they felt like they were going to fall apart. I gave 3 star because of the additional items that were included that are very useful in the kitchen. Don't waste your  money on this set. Invest in a quality set that will last you many years.

product_metadata.title: Farberware 22-Piece Triple Rivet Rust-Resistant Wave Edge High-Carbon Stainless Steel Knife Block Set, Beechwood/Black
features: PROFESSIONAL SET: This 22-piece set includes (1) of each of the following: 8-inch chef's knife, 8-inch slicer knife, 8-inch bread knife, 7-inch Santoku knife, 5-1/2 inch utility knife, 3-1/2 inch paring knife and a sharpening steel
ALSO INCLUDES: Also included in this set are (6) steak knives, a pair of kitchen shears, set of 5 measuring spoons and a set of 3 spatulas
